name: Cache Julia artifacts, packages and registry

cache-name.description: The cache key prefix. The key body automatically includes the OS and, unless disabled, the matrix vars. Include any other parameters/details in this prefix to e

include-matrix.description: Whether to include the matrix values when constructing the cache key.

depot.description: Path to a Julia depot directory where cached data will be saved to and restored from.

cache-artifacts.description: Whether to cache the depot's `artifacts` directory.

cache-packages.description: Whether to cache the depot's `packages` directory.

cache-registries.description: Whether to cache the depot's `registries` directory.

cache-compiled.description: Whether to cache the depot's `compiled` directory.

cache-scratchspaces.description: Whether to cache the depot's `scratchspaces` directory.

cache-logs.description: Whether to cache the depot's `logs` directory. This helps automatic `Pkg.gc()` keep the cache size down.

delete-old-caches.description: Whether to delete old caches for the given key.

token.description: A GitHub PAT. Requires `repo` scope to enable the deletion of old caches.
